rows.symptom: revenue, trailing_7d_revenue in rpt_revenue_dashboard look wrong
rows.sql:
select g.customer_id,
       g.region,
       g.segment,
       coalesce(sum(i.net_revenue), 0) as revenue,
       count(distinct i.order_id) as orders
from int_customer_geo g
left join int_order_items i
  on i.customer_id = g.customer_id
  and i.order_date > (select as_of from meta) - 90
  and i.order_date <= (select as_of from meta)
group by g.customer_id, g.region, g.segment
rows.reason: Missing date filter caused revenue to include all time values, making rpt_revenue_dashboard revenue and trailing_7d_revenue appear wrong. Added filter to int_order_items to limit to the last 90 days.

Because the missing column prevents the node from running, the downstream marts and the report never refresh.

       count(distinct order_id) as orders,
       sum(net_revenue) as revenue
from int_order_items
where order_date >= (select as_of from meta) - 90
  and order_date <= (select as_of from meta)

rows.reason: The original query excluded the current as_of date with '<', causing the latest_day and trailing_7d_revenue to be off. Changed to inclusive range using '>=' and '<='.
rows.result: report came back, warehouse still wrong

rows.sql:
select m.region, m.segment,
       sum(m.revenue) as revenue,
       sum(m.orders) as orders,
       (select max(order_date) from mart_daily_revenue) as latest_day,
       (select sum(revenue)
          from mart_daily_revenue
         where order_date >= (select max(order_date) from mart_daily_revenue) - 6) as trailing_7d_revenue
  from mart_customer_revenue m
 group by m.region, m.segment
rows.reason: The trailing 7‑day revenue excluded the most recent day due to a strict '>' filter. Changed to '>=' so the last 7 days (including the latest day) are summed.
